trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts that performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including Arma Angelus band info and Spike Slawson info. Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents including Celtic punk definition and Tim McIlrath info. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents (titles only) including Tim McIlrath, Spike Slawson, and Celtic punk related articles.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents using the claim verbatim. The summarizer correctly identified that Tim McIlrath was the bass guitarist of Arma Angelus and noted the lack of explicit Celtic punk classification for Spike Slawson. Query generators produced increasingly specific queries attempting to verify the Celtic punk classification. All three retrievals completed and returned relevant documents. The final output contains 24 documents as specified by the pipeline design. While the summaries identified factual issues with the claim itself, this is the correct behavior of a summarizer analyzing evidence. No structural failures, premature terminations, or missing expected steps occurred.
